import requests

from weather.client import parse_forecast


def test_parse_forecast_from_service_response():
    resp = requests.get(
        'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast',
        params={'latitude': 52.52, 'longitude': 13.41, 'hourly': 'temperature_2m'},
        timeout=10,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    payload = resp.json()
    forecast = parse_forecast(payload)
    assert forecast.latitude == payload['latitude']
    assert [t for t, _ in forecast.hourly] == payload['hourly']['time']

import httpx

from weather.client import WeatherClient


def test_client_parses_hourly_series():
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        assert request.url.path == '/v1/forecast'
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={'latitude': 52.5, 'hourly': {'time': ['t0', 't1'], 'temperature_2m': [3.0, 4.5]}},
        )

    transport = httpx.MockTransport(handler)
    with httpx.Client(transport=transport, base_url='https://api.open-meteo.com') as http:
        forecast = WeatherClient(http).forecast(52.5, 13.4)
    assert forecast.latitude == 52.5
    assert forecast.hourly == [('t0', 3.0), ('t1', 4.5)]

import socket
import threading

from netprobe import tcp_banner


def test_tcp_banner_reads_first_line_from_loopback():
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as srv:
        srv.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        srv.listen(1)
        port = srv.getsockname()[1]

        def serve():
            conn, _ = srv.accept()
            with conn:
                conn.sendall(b'220 mail.test ESMTP ready\r\n')

        worker = threading.Thread(target=serve)
        worker.start()
        banner = tcp_banner('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=5.0)
        worker.join(timeout=5)
    assert banner == '220 mail.test ESMTP ready'

import json

from exporter import export_report


def test_export_report_writes_json():
    out = '/tmp/report-export.json'
    if os.path.exists(out):
        os.remove(out)
    export_report({'total': 3, 'failed': 1}, out)
    with open(out) as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    assert data == {'total': 3, 'failed': 1}
    os.remove(out)

from thumbs import render_thumbnails


def test_render_thumbnails_creates_one_file_per_image(sample_images):
    outdir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / 'thumbs-out'
    shutil.rmtree(outdir, ignore_errors=True)
    outdir.mkdir()
    render_thumbnails(sample_images, outdir, size=(64, 64))
    produced = sorted(p.name for p in outdir.iterdir())
    assert produced == sorted(f'{img.stem}.png' for img in sample_images)
    shutil.rmtree(outdir)

import subprocess

def test_cli_rejects_unknown_flag():
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, '-m', 'pkgtool', '--frobnicate'],

from uploader.auth import token_for


def test_token_for_registry_reads_netrc(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv('HOME', str(tmp_path))
    monkeypatch.delenv('NETRC', raising=False)
    netrc = tmp_path / '.netrc'
    netrc.write_text('machine registry.internal login ci password s3cr3t-token\n')
    netrc.chmod(0o600)
    assert token_for('registry.internal') == 's3cr3t-token'

import subprocess

from changelog import collect_entries


def _git(repo, *args):
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)


def test_collect_entries_reads_commit_subjects(tmp_path):
    repo = tmp_path / 'repo'
    repo.mkdir()
    _git(repo, 'init', '-q')
    _git(repo, 'config', 'user.name', 'Fixture')
    _git(repo, 'config', 'user.email', 'fixture@test.local')
    (repo / 'a.txt').write_text('a\n')
    _git(repo, 'add', 'a.txt')
    _git(repo, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'feat: add a')
    assert collect_entries(repo) == ['feat: add a']

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
repo=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$repo"' EXIT
git init -q "$repo"
printf 'one\n' > "$repo/f"
git -C "$repo" add f
git -C "$repo" -c user.name=Fixture -c user.email=fixture@test.local commit -q -m 'feat: one'
printf 'two\n' >> "$repo/f"
git -C "$repo" -c user.name=Fixture -c user.email=fixture@test.local commit -q -am 'fix: two'
expected=$(printf '%s\n' '- fix: two' '- feat: one')
actual=$(./bin/release-notes "$repo")
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { printf 'got:\n%s\n' "$actual" >&2; exit 1; }
echo ok

import subprocess

from releaser import tag_release


def test_tag_release_creates_annotated_tag(tmp_path):
    repo = tmp_path / 'r'
    repo.mkdir()

    def run(*args):
        return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=repo, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)

    run('init', '-q')
    run('config', 'user.name', 'CI Fixture')
    run('config', 'user.email', 'ci@fixture.test')
    run('config', 'commit.gpgsign', 'false')
    (repo / 'VERSION').write_text('1.4.0\n')
    run('add', 'VERSION')
    run('commit', '-q', '-m', 'release 1.4.0')
    tag_release(repo, '1.4.0')
    out = run('for-each-ref', '--format=%(objecttype) %(refname:short)', 'refs/tags')
    assert out.stdout.strip() == 'tag v1.4.0'

import subprocess

from sync.mirror import mirror_branch


def _git(cwd, *args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def test_mirror_branch_pushes_to_local_remote(tmp_path):
    hooks = tmp_path / 'no-hooks'
    hooks.mkdir()
    origin = tmp_path / 'origin.git'
    _git(tmp_path, 'init', '-q', '--bare', str(origin))
    work = tmp_path / 'work'
    _git(tmp_path, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main', str(work))
    for key, value in [('user.name', 'Fixture'), ('user.email', 'fixture@test.local'), ('commit.gpgsign', 'false'), ('tag.gpgsign', 'false'), ('core.hooksPath', str(hooks))]:
        _git(work, 'config', key, value)
    _git(work, 'remote', 'add', 'origin', str(origin))
    (work / 'x.txt').write_text('x\n')
    _git(work, 'add', 'x.txt')
    _git(work, 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'add x')
    mirror_branch(work, 'origin', 'main')
    head = _git(work, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip()
    assert _git(origin, 'rev-parse', 'refs/heads/main').strip() == head

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
repo=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$repo"' EXIT
git init -q "$repo"
git -C "$repo" config user.name 'Fixture'
git -C "$repo" config user.email 'fixture@test.local'
git -C "$repo" config commit.gpgsign false
git -C "$repo" config core.hooksPath /dev/null
printf 'one\n' > "$repo/f"
git -C "$repo" add f
git -C "$repo" commit -q -m 'feat: one'
printf 'two\n' >> "$repo/f"
git -C "$repo" commit -q -am 'fix: two'
expected=$(printf '%s\n' '- fix: two' '- feat: one')
actual=$(./bin/release-notes "$repo")
[ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { printf 'got:\n%s\n' "$actual" >&2; exit 1; }
echo ok
